verses.text: I said, “Please listen, leaders of Jacob and rulers of Israel! Isn’t it your job to know what is just?
“But you hate what is good and love what is evil. You tear off people’s skin and strip flesh from their bones.
“You eat my people’s flesh, strip their skin, break their bones, and chop them up like meat for a pot, like food for a cooking kettle.
“Then they will cry out to the LORD, but he won’t answer. At that time he will hide his face from them, because their actions have been evil.
The LORD says this about prophets who lead my people astray: if people feed them, they announce peace; if not, they declare war against them.
“So night will come for you, with no visions; darkness, with no divination. The sun will set on these prophets, and their day will turn black.
“The seers will be ashamed and the fortune-tellers disgraced. They will all cover their mouths, because God has no answer for them.”
But as for me, I am filled with power by the LORD’s Spirit, with justice and strength, to announce Jacob’s rebellion and Israel’s sin.
Please listen, leaders of Jacob and rulers of Israel, you who hate justice and twist everything that is right,
who build Zion with bloodshed and Jerusalem with injustice.
Her leaders judge for bribes, her priests teach for a fee, and her prophets tell fortunes for money. Yet they lean on the LORD and say, ‘Isn’t the LORD among us? No disaster will come.’
“Because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field; Jerusalem will become piles of rubble, and the temple mountain will become overgrown like a forest hill.”
